note: One row is one species running one scenario of its own characteristic family. steps is the exact call list: the Web port replays it against its own implementation and must return the same result and reach the same state after every step, not only at the end. 'a' always owns the row's characteristic, 't' is a characteristic-free dummy and any other name is spawned by the scenario. Healing projections handed to the engine are the identity, so a recorded heal is the characteristic's own amount before received-healing modifiers.

unitTemplate.note: Both sides are built from this template; only the actor's speciesId is replaced by the row's speciesId. A scenario may change side, slot, stats and flags through its own steps.

randomness.label: pet-design-trait.status
randomness.note: BattleUnit.setRandomTrace returns 0 for every label while these rows are recorded, so each status application the engine attempts succeeds and no draw depends on the host.

powerRule.java: applyPowerBonus multiplies the computed damage by (100 + X) / 100 with X clamped to capPercent; powerBonusPercent is 0 for every other family.
powerRule.divergence: Java has no flat-Power code path, so it cannot referee the magnitude of the 51 workbook traits that add Power instead of a percent. Those rows grade trigger, rhythm, stacking and consumption only.
